questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Eastern Storm or Limpopo Lillies?

questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 421, against Limpopo Lillies on 2011/02/27.

questions.question: At which ground did Koketso Mhlanga record their career-best bowling figures (2-15, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval, against Heat on 2022/10/30.
